title: Siman 269
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: בַּעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יֵשׁ בְּחִינַת רָצוֹא וָשׁוֹב, וְזאת הַבְּחִינָה הִיא אֵצֶל כָּל אָדָם אֲפִלּוּ אֵצֶל הַפָּחוּת
segments.en: (29.) Wednesday the 4th of Elul 5569 in Breslov. He said: "I am the most humble of all the famous ones — for each of them has his service and I am humble — meaning they are not considered anything by me at all. For the attribute of humility is to not regard oneself as anything — to be as nothing and nothingness in one's own eyes. And since they are not considered anything by me at all — it turns out I am humble toward them. Explanation: of all the famous ones I am the humble one — this one does this and that one does that — and I do not regard any of them.
